reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited paragraphs (13.4, 13.5/13.6 ownership text, 14.5, 14.10, Exhibit D §5) contain no non-solicitation, no-hire, or anti-poaching covenant binding Corio (our client), so the preferred position 'No non-solicit on Customer' is already satisfied.
Redline is identical to the original text and no counterparty comment is proposed, which is the expected output for a compliant finding — no negotiation ask is generated.

The failed deterministic checks (12-month duration, general-solicitation carve-out) are parameters of the fallback position and are correctly treated as inapplicable where no restrictive covenant exists; they are heuristics, not evidence of a missed clause.

Rationale accurately reflects the record, including the integration clause (14.10) that limits incorporation by reference to the Exhibits, NDA and Statement of Work, and the 'Personnel' heading in Exhibit D §5 which only assigns a sales/marketing contact and imposes no hiring restriction.
Retention as internal evidence only, with the fallback noted for use if a personnel covenant is later proposed, is appropriate handling for this finding.
